newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Unilever says conclusions can't be drawn from Q4.
newsitem.headline: Unilever says conclusions can't be drawn from Q4.

text.p: Unilever NV /Plc said on Tuesday few conclusions could be drawn from its fourth quarter results.

"Few conclusions can be drawn from this quarter's results, due to the impact of the different phasing of exceptional items in 1996 as against 1995," it said in a statement accompanying fourth-quarter and full-year 1996 results.
Unilever said fourth quarter net profit in guilders came out 10 percent higher than in the same period of 1995 if exceptional items and lower pension costs were excluded.

In the year as a whole there were exceptional credits of 280 million guilders and these were used to fund restructuring of 888 million guilders, while maintaining net exceptional items in operating profit at the 1995 level, it added.
